content.value: Calculate the value of N for the following code which generates 5 seconds delay if 8086 system (09) frequency is 4 MHz.

MOV BX, N ; 04  
REPEAT: MOV CX, AFFOH ; 04  
BACK: DEC CX ;02  
JNZ BACK ;16/4  
DEC BX ; 02  
NOP ; 03  
JNZ REPEAT ;16/4
